newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 77.9 bln dmk in repos, drains funds.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 77.9 bln dmk in repos, drains funds.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it allocated 77.9 billion marks of securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed interest rate of 3.0 percent.
The German central bank accepted 29.4 percent of the bids made for the 14-day funds.
A repo pact for 78.9 billion marks at a fixed 3.0 percent rate expires on Wednesday, so a net one billion marks is flowing out of the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 265.1 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week.
